# md4c

This directory vendors the upstream `md4c.h` and `md4c.c` files fetched on
2026-09-23 from <https://github.com/mity/md4c>.

The build defines `MD4C_USE_UTF16` on Windows so parsed text and attributes stay
in the native wide string form used by Spark.
